name: Hudson Hollow Retreats
tagline: Farm offsite days in the Hudson Valley for 20 to 60, two hours from Manhattan.
bio: I'm Claire Wu. Our farm has a barn for working sessions, a kitchen that cooks what we grow, and pottery and flower sessions for the afternoon. We arrange the coach from the city.
terms: Free to cancel up to 30 days before; 50% inside 30 days.
backupPlan: Rain plan: the barn holds everyone.

experiences.name: Farm offsite day
experiences.desc: Morning working session in the barn, farm lunch, an afternoon pottery or flower session, dinner by the fire.
experiences.allIn: Coach, venue, food, one session, staff and tax. Overnight stays quoted separately.
experiences.av: Screen, mic and Wi-Fi in the barn
experiences.access: Barn and dining room are step-free.
